decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
That details of materials,  pursuant to condition 3,  of  approval ref. 00423/56/P4, for the erection of a 4 storey side extension and conversion of existing dwellinghouse to 3 x 1 bedroom flats and 5 x 2 bedroom flats inc. replacement windows, vehicular/pedestrian access, 8 parking spaces (3 of which are covered)  covered cycle stand, refuge storage area and landscaping, dated 25/7/2002, received  5/12/2003 and 2/1/2004, be approved.
description: Following approval for erection of a four storey side extension and conversion of existing dwellinghouse to 3 one bedroom flats and 5 two bedroom flats incorporating replacement windows vehicular/pedestrian access, 8 parking spaces (3 of which are covered) covered cycle stand, refuse storage area, and landscaping - details submitted pursuant to Condition 3 (materials) of planning permission reference 00423/56/P4 dated 25/07/2002.
